title: Thai Crunchy Mushroom Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Thai-inspired dish featuring crunchy vegetables, savory mushrooms, and a warm wrap.
instructions: 1. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the sliced cucumber and shredded carrot to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together the Thai chili sauce, soy sauce, and honey.
5. Pour the sauce over the vegetables in the skillet and stir to combine.
6. Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
7. Assemble the wrap by spooning the vegetable mixture onto the center of the wrap.
8. Top with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
